拖动参数 `a` 后，曲线和表格会在本地同步更新。曲线数据由 `@sample` 在闭区间 `[-2, 2]` 内取 9 个等距点生成，属于合成数学示例。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput, chart, table])
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => $a * x * x, -2, 2, 9)
aInput = Slider(label="参数 a", bind=$a, min=-5, max=5, step=0.1, digits=2)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], unit="u", title="合成数学示例：y = a·x²", xLabel="x", yLabel="y")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":2},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":2}])
```
